## What's new

- App icons in the Home and Apps grids now use grayscale, including the original Duokan icon.
- **Settings → Bookshelf Sources** lets you choose which sources appear in the Bookshelf. Local books and WeRead are both enabled by default. Turning a source off stops its automatic refresh from the Bookshelf without clearing sign-in data or cached books.

## Reading from the bookshelf

- **Duokan:** After copying new books to `Books/`, open the Bookshelf in the original Duokan launcher so it can index them. Ginkgo opens indexed books through deep links.
- **WeRead:** Sign in to WeRead from Ginkgo to sync your shelf and sign in separately in the WeRead e-ink app to read.

This release targets the first-generation Xiaomi MiReader (Android 8.1). Install the signed APK over your existing Ginkgo release without uninstalling it.
